```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 860
library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Shinylive App for Conjugate Bayesian Updating"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 4,
      selectInput("model", "Model",
                  choices = c("Bernoulli - Beta" = "bb", "Poisson - Gamma" = "pg",
                              "Normal (known sigma) - Normal" = "nn")),
      conditionalPanel(
        "input.model == 'bb'",
        numericInput("a1", "prior alpha1 (successes)", value = 1, min = 0.1, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("a0", "prior alpha0 (failures)", value = 1, min = 0.1, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("n_bb", "n (trials)", value = 10, min = 1, step = 1),
        numericInput("y_bb", "y (successes observed)", value = 7, min = 0, step = 1)
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        "input.model == 'pg'",
        numericInput("alpha", "prior alpha (shape)", value = 2, min = 0.1, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("beta", "prior beta (rate)", value = 1, min = 0.1, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("n_pg", "n (observations)", value = 8, min = 1, step = 1),
        numericInput("S_pg", "sum of counts", value = 29, min = 0, step = 1)
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        "input.model == 'nn'",
        numericInput("mu0", "prior mu0 (mean)", value = 0, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("kappa0", "prior kappa0 (pseudo-sample-size)", value = 1, min = 0.1, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("sigma_nn", "sigma (known)", value = 2, min = 0.1, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("n_nn", "n (observations)", value = 15, min = 1, step = 1),
        numericInput("ybar_nn", "sample mean y-bar", value = 3, step = 0.5)
      ),
      helpText("Dashed = prior, solid = posterior. The dotted vertical line ",
               "is the MLE (y/n for Bernoulli, S/n for Poisson, y-bar for Normal). ",
               "*Log marginal likelihood is exact for Bernoulli; for Poisson ",
               "and Normal it is shown up to an additive constant that ",
               "depends only on the individual data points (not part of the ",
               "summary inputs here) and cancels when comparing priors for ",
               "the same data.")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      width = 8,
      plotOutput("densplot", height = "380px"),
      tableOutput("summtab")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  output$densplot <- renderPlot({
    par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
    if (input$model == "bb") {
      a1 <- input$a1; a0 <- input$a0; n <- input$n_bb; y <- input$y_bb
      post_a1 <- a1 + y; post_a0 <- a0 + (n - y)
      xs <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 500)
      ylim <- c(0, max(dbeta(xs, a1, a0), dbeta(xs, post_a1, post_a0)) * 1.1)
      curve(dbeta(x, a1, a0), 0, 1, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "gray40",
            xlab = expression(theta), ylab = "density", ylim = ylim)
      curve(dbeta(x, post_a1, post_a0), add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "steelblue")
      abline(v = y / n, lty = 3)
      legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = c(2, 3), lty = c(2, 1), col = c("gray40", "steelblue"),
             legend = c("prior", "posterior"))
    } else if (input$model == "pg") {
      alpha <- input$alpha; beta <- input$beta; n <- input$n_pg; S <- input$S_pg
      post_alpha <- alpha + S; post_beta <- beta + n
      hi <- max(qgamma(0.999, alpha, beta), qgamma(0.999, post_alpha, post_beta))
      xs <- seq(0, hi, length.out = 500)
      ylim <- c(0, max(dgamma(xs, alpha, beta), dgamma(xs, post_alpha, post_beta)) * 1.1)
      curve(dgamma(x, alpha, beta), 0, hi, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "gray40",
            xlab = expression(lambda), ylab = "density", ylim = ylim)
      curve(dgamma(x, post_alpha, post_beta), add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "firebrick")
      abline(v = S / n, lty = 3)
      legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = c(2, 3), lty = c(2, 1), col = c("gray40", "firebrick"),
             legend = c("prior", "posterior"))
    } else {
      mu0 <- input$mu0; kappa0 <- input$kappa0; sigma <- input$sigma_nn
      n <- input$n_nn; ybar <- input$ybar_nn
      post_kappa <- kappa0 + n
      post_mu <- (kappa0 * mu0 + n * ybar) / post_kappa
      post_sd <- sigma / sqrt(post_kappa)
      prior_sd <- sigma / sqrt(kappa0)
      lo <- min(mu0 - 3 * prior_sd, post_mu - 3 * post_sd)
      hi <- max(mu0 + 3 * prior_sd, post_mu + 3 * post_sd)
      xs <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = 500)
      ylim <- c(0, max(dnorm(xs, mu0, prior_sd), dnorm(xs, post_mu, post_sd)) * 1.1)
      curve(dnorm(x, mu0, prior_sd), lo, hi, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "gray40",
            xlab = expression(mu), ylab = "density", ylim = ylim)
      curve(dnorm(x, post_mu, post_sd), add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "darkorchid")
      abline(v = ybar, lty = 3)
      legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = c(2, 3), lty = c(2, 1), col = c("gray40", "darkorchid"),
             legend = c("prior", "posterior"))
    }
  })

  output$summtab <- renderTable({
    if (input$model == "bb") {
      a1 <- input$a1; a0 <- input$a0; n <- input$n_bb; y <- input$y_bb
      post_a1 <- a1 + y; post_a0 <- a0 + (n - y)
      logmarg    <- lbeta(post_a1, post_a0) - lbeta(a1, a0)         # exact
      pred_mean  <- post_a1 / (post_a1 + post_a0)
      pred_sd    <- sqrt(pred_mean * (1 - pred_mean))
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("prior mean", "MLE (y/n)", "log marginal likelihood*",
                     "posterior distribution", "posterior mean", "posterior sd",
                     "95% credible interval", "predictive distribution",
                     "predictive mean", "predictive sd"),
        value = c(sprintf("%.3f", a1 / (a1 + a0)),
                  sprintf("%.3f", y / n),
                  sprintf("%.3f", logmarg),
                  sprintf("Beta(%.2f, %.2f)", post_a1, post_a0),
                  sprintf("%.3f", pred_mean),
                  sprintf("%.3f", sqrt(post_a1 * post_a0 / ((post_a1 + post_a0)^2 * (post_a1 + post_a0 + 1)))),
                  sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", qbeta(0.025, post_a1, post_a0), qbeta(0.975, post_a1, post_a0)),
                  sprintf("Bernoulli(%.3f)", pred_mean),
                  sprintf("%.3f", pred_mean), sprintf("%.3f", pred_sd)))
    } else if (input$model == "pg") {
      alpha <- input$alpha; beta <- input$beta; n <- input$n_pg; S <- input$S_pg
      post_alpha <- alpha + S; post_beta <- beta + n
      logmarg   <- alpha * log(beta) - lgamma(alpha) + lgamma(post_alpha) -
        post_alpha * log(post_beta)                                 # up to -sum(log(y_i!))
      nb_prob   <- post_beta / (post_beta + 1)
      pred_mean <- post_alpha / post_beta
      pred_sd   <- sqrt(pred_mean * (1 + 1 / post_beta))
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("prior mean", "MLE (S/n)", "log marginal likelihood*",
                     "posterior distribution", "posterior mean", "posterior sd",
                     "95% credible interval", "predictive distribution",
                     "predictive mean", "predictive sd"),
        value = c(sprintf("%.3f", alpha / beta),
                  sprintf("%.3f", S / n),
                  sprintf("%.3f", logmarg),
                  sprintf("Gamma(%.2f, %.2f)", post_alpha, post_beta),
                  sprintf("%.3f", pred_mean),
                  sprintf("%.3f", sqrt(post_alpha) / post_beta),
                  sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", qgamma(0.025, post_alpha, post_beta), qgamma(0.975, post_alpha, post_beta)),
                  sprintf("NegBin(%.2f, %.3f)", post_alpha, nb_prob),
                  sprintf("%.3f", pred_mean), sprintf("%.3f", pred_sd)))
    } else {
      mu0 <- input$mu0; kappa0 <- input$kappa0; sigma <- input$sigma_nn
      n <- input$n_nn; ybar <- input$ybar_nn
      post_kappa <- kappa0 + n
      post_mu <- (kappa0 * mu0 + n * ybar) / post_kappa
      post_sd <- sigma / sqrt(post_kappa)
      logmarg <- -n / 2 * log(2 * pi * sigma^2) + 0.5 * log(kappa0 / post_kappa) -
        kappa0 * n * (mu0 - ybar)^2 / (2 * sigma^2 * post_kappa)     # up to -SS/(2 sigma^2)
      pred_sd <- sqrt(post_sd^2 + sigma^2)
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("prior mean", "MLE (y-bar)", "log marginal likelihood*",
                     "posterior distribution", "posterior mean", "posterior sd",
                     "95% credible interval", "predictive distribution",
                     "predictive mean", "predictive sd"),
        value = c(sprintf("%.3f", mu0),
                  sprintf("%.3f", ybar),
                  sprintf("%.3f", logmarg),
                  sprintf("N(%.3f, %.3f^2)", post_mu, post_sd),
                  sprintf("%.3f", post_mu),
                  sprintf("%.3f", post_sd),
                  sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", qnorm(0.025, post_mu, post_sd), qnorm(0.975, post_mu, post_sd)),
                  sprintf("N(%.3f, %.3f^2)", post_mu, pred_sd),
                  sprintf("%.3f", post_mu), sprintf("%.3f", pred_sd)))
    }
  }, colnames = FALSE, striped = TRUE)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

## About the app

Lets you explore conjugate Bayesian updating, to see how the prior, the data, and the sample size combine into the posterior. The app above lets you adjust the prior, sample size, and observed data for any of the three conjugate models and watch prior and posterior move together, along with the posterior summary table computed above.

  output$densplot <- renderPlot({
    par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
    if (input$model == "bb") {
      a1 <- input$a1; a0 <- input$a0; n <- input$n_bb; y <- input$y_bb

      xs <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 500)
      ylim <- c(0, max(dbeta(xs, a1, a0), dbeta(xs, post_a1, post_a0)) * 1.1)
      curve(dbeta(x, a1, a0), 0, 1, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "gray40",
            xlab = expression(theta), ylab = "density", ylim = ylim)
      curve(dbeta(x, post_a1, post_a0), add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "steelblue")
      abline(v = y / n, lty = 3)
      legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = c(2, 3), lty = c(2, 1), col = c("gray40", "steelblue"),
             legend = c("prior", "posterior"))
    } else if (input$model == "pg") {
      alpha <- input$alpha; beta <- input$beta; n <- input$n_pg; S <- input$S_pg
      post_alpha <- alpha + S; post_beta <- beta + n
      hi <- max(qgamma(0.999, alpha, beta), qgamma(0.999, post_alpha, post_beta))
      xs <- seq(0, hi, length.out = 500)
      ylim <- c(0, max(dgamma(xs, alpha, beta), dgamma(xs, post_alpha, post_beta)) * 1.1)
      curve(dgamma(x, alpha, beta), 0, hi, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "gray40",
            xlab = expression(lambda), ylab = "density", ylim = ylim)
      curve(dgamma(x, post_alpha, post_beta), add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "firebrick")
      abline(v = S / n, lty = 3)
      legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = c(2, 3), lty = c(2, 1), col = c("gray40", "firebrick"),
             legend = c("prior", "posterior"))
    } else {
      mu0 <- input$mu0; kappa0 <- input$kappa0; sigma <- input$sigma_nn
      n <- input$n_nn; ybar <- input$ybar_nn
      post_kappa <- kappa0 + n
      post_mu <- (kappa0 * mu0 + n * ybar) / post_kappa
      post_sd <- sigma / sqrt(post_kappa)
      prior_sd <- sigma / sqrt(kappa0)
      lo <- min(mu0 - 3 * prior_sd, post_mu - 3 * post_sd)
      hi <- max(mu0 + 3 * prior_sd, post_mu + 3 * post_sd)
      xs <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = 500)
      ylim <- c(0, max(dnorm(xs, mu0, prior_sd), dnorm(xs, post_mu, post_sd)) * 1.1)
      curve(dnorm(x, mu0, prior_sd), lo, hi, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "gray40",
            xlab = expression(mu), ylab = "density", ylim = ylim)
      curve(dnorm(x, post_mu, post_sd), add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "darkorchid")
      abline(v = ybar, lty = 3)
      legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = c(2, 3), lty = c(2, 1), col = c("gray40", "darkorchid"),
             legend = c("prior", "posterior"))
    }
  })

  output$summtab <- renderTable({
    if (input$model == "bb") {
      a1 <- input$a1; a0 <- input$a0; n <- input$n_bb; y <- input$y_bb
      post_a1 <- a1 + y; post_a0 <- a0 + (n - y)

      pred_sd    <- sqrt(pred_mean * (1 - pred_mean))
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("prior mean", "MLE (y/n)", "log marginal likelihood*",

                     "95% credible interval", "predictive distribution",
                     "predictive mean", "predictive sd"),
        value = c(sprintf("%.3f", a1 / (a1 + a0)),

                  sprintf("%.3f", logmarg),

      nb_prob   <- post_beta / (post_beta + 1)
      pred_mean <- post_alpha / post_beta
      pred_sd   <- sqrt(pred_mean * (1 + 1 / post_beta))
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("prior mean", "MLE (S/n)", "log marginal likelihood*",
                     "posterior distribution", "posterior mean", "posterior sd",
                     "95% credible interval", "predictive distribution",
                     "predictive mean", "predictive sd"),
        value = c(sprintf("%.3f", alpha / beta),
                  sprintf("%.3f", S / n),
                  sprintf("%.3f", logmarg),
                  sprintf("Gamma(%.2f, %.2f)", post_alpha, post_beta),
                  sprintf("%.3f", pred_mean),
                  sprintf("%.3f", sqrt(post_alpha) / post_beta),
                  sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", qgamma(0.025, post_alpha, post_beta), qgamma(0.975, post_alpha, post_beta)),
                  sprintf("NegBin(%.2f, %.3f)", post_alpha, nb_prob),
                  sprintf("%.3f", pred_mean), sprintf("%.3f", pred_sd)))
    } else {
      mu0 <- input$mu0; kappa0 <- input$kappa0; sigma <- input$sigma_nn
      n <- input$n_nn; ybar <- input$ybar_nn
      post_kappa <- kappa0 + n
      post_mu <- (kappa0 * mu0 + n * ybar) / post_kappa
      post_sd <- sigma / sqrt(post_kappa)
      logmarg <- -n / 2 * log(2 * pi * sigma^2) + 0.5 * log(kappa0 / post_kappa) -
        kappa0 * n * (mu0 - ybar)^2 / (2 * sigma^2 * post_kappa)     # up to -SS/(2 sigma^2)
      pred_sd <- sqrt(post_sd^2 + sigma^2)
      data.frame(
        quantity = c("prior mean", "MLE (y-bar)", "log marginal likelihood*",
                     "posterior distribution", "posterior mean", "posterior sd",
                     "95% credible interval", "predictive distribution",
                     "predictive mean", "predictive sd"),
        value = c(sprintf("%.3f", mu0),
                  sprintf("%.3f", ybar),
                  sprintf("%.3f", logmarg),
                  sprintf("N(%.3f, %.3f^2)", post_mu, post_sd),
                  sprintf("%.3f", post_mu),
                  sprintf("%.3f", post_sd),
                  sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", qnorm(0.025, post_mu, post_sd), qnorm(0.975, post_mu, post_sd)),
                  sprintf("N(%.3f, %.3f^2)", post_mu, pred_sd),
                  sprintf("%.3f", post_mu), sprintf("%.3f", pred_sd)))
    }
  }, colnames = FALSE, striped = TRUE)
}
